finding.summary: not_found_reason(config) is computed once at create() time from config.model, but make_chat_model (the factory) can be called with a different model argument. If any caller ever passes a non-default model to the factory, the 404 diagnostic baked into LangChainLLM will describe the wrong model/URL (e.g. telling the user CODE_REVIEW_MODEL was sent as X when Y was actually sent), producing a misleading resume hint.
finding.fix: Make not_found a function of the model actually used: pass a callable (e.g. lambda model: not_found_reason_for(config, model)) into LangChainLLM, or have LangChainLLM consult self._model when formatting the 404 message so the diagnostic always matches the model that hit the 404.

label: false_positive
label_reason: Raised in review and merged with the file unchanged.
